actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: seed

facts.text: Empty-v1 is registered with max_episode_steps=200000
EmptyEnv loads the Panda robot by default (robot_uids='panda')
EmptyEnv supports only the reward mode 'none'
With reward mode 'none' the environment returns a zero reward tensor
EmptyEnv.evaluate returns an empty dictionary, so info carries no success or fail key
With no success or fail in info, step returns terminated as a zero boolean tensor
BaseEnv's supported observation modes start with 'state'
When no observation mode is given, BaseEnv takes the first supported mode
A state observation flattens the agent and extra observation dictionaries into one array
An agent's proprioceptive observation is its qpos and qvel
Panda's arm controller lists seven joints and its gripper controller lists two joint names
Panda's rest keyframe stores nine joint values
Panda's first controller configuration is pd_joint_delta_pos
When no control mode is given, an agent uses the first supported control mode
An agent serves a control mode whose configuration is a dict with a CombinedController
The pd_joint_delta_pos arm config sets lower=-0.1, upper=0.1 and use_delta=True and does not set normalize_action
The mimic gripper config sets lower=-0.01 and upper=0.04 and does not set normalize_action
PDJointPosControllerConfig defaults normalize_action to True
PDJointPosMimicControllerConfig subclasses PDJointPosControllerConfig and only sets its controller class
The mimic gripper controller reduces its two joints to one action dimension
A controller calls _clip_and_scale_action_space when its config sets normalize_action
_clip_and_scale_action_space replaces the single action space with normalize_action_space of the original one
normalize_action_space returns Box(-1, 1) with the shape and dtype of the space it is given
clip_and_scale_action clips an action to [-1, 1] and scales it to 0.5 * (high + low) + 0.5 * (high - low) * action
The combined controller flattens the single action spaces of its controllers into one space
A controller exposes its single action space and batches it only when there is more than one environment
An agent's action spaces are those of its current controller
BaseEnv takes its action space and single action space from its agent
BaseEnv's default num_envs is 1
The simulation frequency is 100 Hz and the control frequency is 20 Hz
The MSTimeLimit wrapper truncates at the registered max_episode_steps
TimeLimitWrapper reports truncated when elapsed_steps is at least max_episode_steps

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 records the seed used by the next reset; the fake starts every episode from the same zero joint state, so a seed does not change its trajectory. Upstream ManiSkill seeds its main and episode RNG from the reset seed.

gaps: the fake backend is kinematic: one step adds the scaled joint deltas to qpos, sets the gripper target and clears qvel; SAPIEN PhysX rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuator forces, sensors and noise are not simulated (F0, no dynamics)
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, one step advances simulated time by timestep_ms (50 ms from the 20 Hz control frequency) only
the observation is the 18-element qpos+qvel state of the Panda (nine joints twice) that Empty-v1 uses with its default state observation mode; no camera image, depth or point cloud is returned

the action is ManiSkill's normalised one, eight values in -1..1 (ManiSkill/mani_skill/utils/gym_utils.py:108-110): the fake clips and scales each value as clip_and_scale_action does (gym_utils.py:102-105), to an arm joint delta in -0.1..0.1 or the gripper target in -0.01..0.04, and assigns the same target to both finger joints as the mimic controller broadcasts (pd_joint_pos.py:84-86); instantaneous qpos assignment remains a kinematic placeholder, and the external Panda asset joint limits and drive dynamics are not reproduced

the fake was not compared with the upstream ManiSkill environment (SAPIEN and PyTorch are not installed where the gate runs); reset uses a zero joint state placeholder while upstream loads the Panda articulation pose
the 200000-step Empty-v1 time limit is modelled by the fake, but no package test runs that long
snapshot and restore are not offered: this package's fake exposes no get_state or set_state
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: an e-stop latches the runtime and no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation stays readable
